name: catan

scripts.emulators: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-catan
scripts.test:emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-catan --only auth,firestore,functions "FIREBASE_EMULATORS=1 vitest run src/game/net"
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --only firestore,functions

description: Settlers of Catan board generator, opening-placement helper, dice roller and online play.
